initialization: Reviewed parking-balanced epoch-7 depth head plus the same freshly seeded zero-output camera adapter in both arms; never the overfit tiny-check endpoint.
protection: Only 1553 adapter parameters train. Original depth parameters and every BatchNorm affine weight/buffer remain frozen; Urban body, detection and projected corners remain frozen.
sampler: Each eight-image batch has one eligible draw per critical training cell plus four shuffled broad training images. One epoch is one complete broad pass plus critical oversampling: 384 updates, 3072 draws, all 1536 unique training images visited. Both arms use the same stream.
budget: Five epochs per arm, 1920 optimizer updates per arm; no automatic extension. This is twice the updates per epoch of the old joint-camera pilot, not a compute-matched comparison with that old run.
loss: Sparse raw-metre Huber delta 0.2: 0.8 equal available four-cell means plus 0.2 broad 2-80m, equal images inside each component. Nominal weights do not imply gradient balance.
selection: Lowest development equal-four-cell image-macro MAE, including epoch zero; ties prefer earlier epochs. No held-out selection.
checks: Prospective descriptive research checks: 5% gain versus initialization, no critical cell worse by over 2cm, broad MAE no worse by over 10cm, Vehicle 2-4m beats fixed 4m. Separately test 2% gain over the matched fixed-camera control. These are not product qualification or statistical-significance claims.

prior_evidence.reason: Training MAE fell about 19.5%, but mixed training loss fell only 7.1% in the actual-camera arm, below the original 10% check. That check remains failed.
prior_evidence.interpretation: Tiny fit did not improve overall development error. This separately authorized exploratory pilot tests broader training coverage; it does not retroactively pass the tiny sanity gate. Development frames have already been inspected.
